create_InferenceSettings: create an InferenceSettings dataclass with tf32, activation checkpointing, merge mole, and compile flags
create_MLIPInferenceCheckpoint: create an MLIPInferenceCheckpoint dataclass with model config, state dict, ema state dict, and tasks config
run_inference_settings_default: run the inference_settings_default function to get default InferenceSettings for most systems and models
run_inference_settings_turbo: run the inference_settings_turbo function to get optimized InferenceSettings for long simulations with constant composition
run_guess_inference_settings: run guess_inference_settings to resolve a string name or InferenceSettings object into an InferenceSettings instance
